M1.implementation: train-only variable-order ngram, explicitly NOT original IDyOM

M3.implementation: train-only sonority ngram, unverified chord tokenization

M7.implementation: tonic-chord and fifth-distance proxy, NOT Lerdahl TPS

M10.implementation: measure-boundary rests and motif grouping proxy

M15.implementation: MIDI vertical interval clash, NOT acoustic roughness

M16.implementation: independent track-direction proxy; voice identity unverified

M17.implementation: multiscale feature memory, NOT fitted Farbood original

M19.implementation: Huron ITPRA: cognitive framework, not inferred mental states

M20.implementation: within-piece motif repetition and training-only ngram

M23.implementation: median and quartiles of real raters, evaluation side only

notes_about_scope: jSymbolic/Melody global descriptors remain static across a piece; only window/event features vary
original jSymbolic outputs loaded from SHA256-verified local ACE XML batches
original IDyOM Lisp is not executed; the explicitly distinct ngram baseline uses only training MIDI
theory_M7-M20 are operational probes, not replications of full cognitive models
train-only expectation prior fitted on 111 MIDI pieces
human_aggregation: median per musical measure across all valid individual 30-rater V/A series

limitations: emotion estimates learned from other VGMIDI human ratings: not unsupervised theory-to-emotion
VGMIDI self-reports are subjective; median and quartiles preserve disagreement
MIDI metre and raw annotation measure grids aligned by bar count; invalid files rejected
original IDyOM Lisp unavailable (n-gram baseline is not IDyOM)
jSymbolic original Java features require a verified --jsymbolic-ace directory
new test split chosen before viewing its human label series; still internal to VGMIDI
no independent external EMOPIA validation, no causal inference
possible stylistic similarities across different arrangements, despite filename-disjoint pieces
